title: Trinity Rewrite Lhs Graph Sync
description: Fix trinity/rewrite LHS/RHS pattern graph rendering (broken Puzzle2dCanvas wiring), add variable-name label clarity, bidirectional hover/selection bridge between LHS/RHS graphs and generated Jack query text, and extend to Before/After bound-node highlighting.
summary:
Fixed Trinity Rewrite LHS/RHS pattern graph rendering and completed the bidirectional hover/selection bridge.

**Root cause (rendering):** Rewrite fixture handles used short ids (`out`/`in`) while edges referenced qualified endpoints (`match-a:out`). Puzzle2d deferred WASM scene push until edges synced, so nodes never painted.

**Fix:** `rewriteGraphNode` now emits node-qualified handle ids (`${nodeId}:in|out`). Added `rewrite-lhs`/`rewrite-rhs` to `fixtureMetaKindCatalogBundle`.

**Also delivered:** Puzzle2dCanvas wiring for LHS/RHS hosts, `var : Kind` labels, writer external occurrence props, controller bridge (LHS/RHS/Jack + Before/After highlighted_ids), tests (28 vitest in trinity-rewrite-play). Browser verified on :6069 — LHS/RHS graphs render with nodes and flow edges.
